dialogues.speaker: Pisemsky
dialogues.text: Oh, I was just reliving last night's performance.

dialogues.speaker: Pisemsky
dialogues.text: You see, traditional Snezhnayan opera tends to focus on grand tragedies — filling emotional gaps with overly elaborate lyrics...

dialogues.speaker: Pisemsky
dialogues.text: But the performances by Miss Odette and Lady Vodyanitsa discard all that unnecessary excess. Elegant. Truly, what elegance!

dialogues.speaker: Pisemsky
dialogues.text: Take Miss Odette's footwork, for example — it is less "dance" than it is "martial form." You follow my meaning, yes?
